description: Put 2 to 10 patterns side by side on the same market, timeframe and breakout side.

market.description: Market. all pools the markets that have this timeframe. Default: all.

side.description: Breakout side. Patterns recorded on both sides have up and down rows and no all row; every other pattern has only all. Default: all.

timeframe.description: Bar timeframe. Default: 1d. Stocks, ETFs, indices and commodities have 1d and 1w only.

name: compare_patterns
title: Compare patterns
